description: Implementation of the NoteService interface, providing methods to perform CRUD operations on notes using a JPA repository. Contains methods for retrieving all notes, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting notes.

classes.name: NoteServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of the NoteService interface, providing business logic for managing notes via a JPA repository.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes as a list of NoteResponse DTOs.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, returns an Optional containing NoteResponse if found.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note from NoteRequest DTO and returns the created note as NoteResponse.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with data from NoteRequest, returns an Optional of the updated NoteResponse.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID, returns true if deletion was successful, false otherwise.
